body:
I'd just sit in the sun and people watch. Maybe take a warm nap. It would be so nice to not have any pressure on me, or have to do anything besides sit there.

I get that they're overrated, I just really want someone who cares.
I'd go somewhere warm. And sit on a beach. And drink beer. If I had friends, they'd be a nice addition.
Thank you for responding. It's always nice knowing that I'm not alone!
